name: Rent (residential)
plan_note: MODELLED, not observed: Labour Bureau CPI-IW housing-group indices (all-India half-yearly + 78-centre panel) -> Rajkot half-year step = mean of an empirical-Bayes shrunk additive-deviation model and a pooled-parameter Kalman ratio model (rpi/rentsignal.py v3; selection rule fixed on panel RMSE before comparison with MoSPI); no MoSPI value enters the signal. Fails the monthly-correlation gate (structurally unpassable by any trend-type signal) so it is gated by a calibrated TREND gate (cumulative and 12-month gap within 1.645*sd*sqrt(n) of the official rent index); that gate change is for R001 only and was adopted by user decision 2026-10-06 after the corr gate failed. Re-gated every refresh; needs a new Labour Bureau half-year row each Jan/Jul (inventory AJ).
